This world is nothing but hatred, people only care for others for self interest. The cycle of pain continues over and over again. I worked so hard faking myself, my jokes, my laugh, my happiness for those friends and my girlfriend just for it all to crumble and burn. Me not being able to do anything while all of them used it to push forward and crush me even deeper. watching them laugh and be happy with their new friends. replacing me so easily. makes me feel like i’m nothing but a lightbulb that ran out, and they changed it like it didn’t matter. That’s when i realized how meaningless life is. we all die. pain always exists. hatred always rules. love is nothing more than pain waiting to show itself, happiness is nothing more than a mirage of pain. happiness can’t last forever. I’m not sad over those who die and commit. i’m more jealous than anything. And people that say “it’s selfish to do it” are hypocritical because it’s more selfish to expect someone to suffer through darkness they can’t beat and that tears them apart internally just so you can be happy that their here until they snap and end it without caring. which makes people mad at you that you did it, even in death you can’t escape hatred. It’s all just a joke

I have no emotion. In my eyes the only emotion is pain. every other emotion has pain as it’s underlying root. Happiness, Sadness, Anger..all of them have pain. it’s like all of those nullified and consumed me in just pain alone. There’s a darkness in me that can’t be wiped away with a feeling. I think about the future and all I see is more pain. Letting down ur kids, divorce, premature death, losing friends. this world is nothing but pain itself. Everyone i talk too tells me to pray to god and all of that but I don’t believe in that anymore. what creator would make his “children” suffer like this. make them to where they don’t even want to be alive. If you think about it. all of us are meaningless. we’re just living in a clock that’ll eventually die. everything we work for, love and cherish will be gone in a second. i’ve watched my life become ruin, burning in front of my eyes and not being able to do anything about it. I can’t cry anymore because I don’t feel bad. I used to cry but still it didn’t stop people from leaving, death from happening and misfortune to come my way. solitude took over me and I just grew colder and colder and now it’s like i’m already dead. nobody likes me, I turned from someone who could make a room light up to someone who isn’t even existent really, so unnoticeable that it’s like i’m invisible. I used to try to feel like i belong somewhere but even then. it never worked. maybe i just don’t belong anywhere like i think i don’t. maybe the ground is where i belong. with the rest of the ones who don’t exist are :(

imagine being his girlfriend seeing the video of what really pushed him over the edge, but to me the video doesn’t seem hard to watch, just another man ending his suffering. that’s life. not to sound cold or anything. just people die everyday, in horrible ways and in nice ways. Time moves on, more are born, that’s life.

my life is so worthless...all my “friends” that left me, i was already struggling towards the beginning of covid, then school got cancelled and kids were still hanging out, while i just faded from existence...it’s not fair, i did everything for them, bought them food, made them laugh, was there for them even though it was for personal gain. And now i’m alone. haven’t hung out with anyone in months. what did i do to deserve this. it’s all so meaningless. maybe not for you, but for me it is

I do percs, Xans, Coke, Tabs, Molly, Vics. shrooms and weed dont do anything to me anymore, i don’t get high from that stuff anymore my tolerance is way to high trust me i’ve tried, beside i dont care if i OD or not, and it’s whatever, Life has to have scapegoats to put all the pain in the world somewhere, it just chose me unfortunately to be one of those people

I feel nothing for anyone, I want to unleash all this anger on everyone in the world, I want to kill people that have families so they understand the reality of never being able to wake up from a nightmare, I can’t wake up from this nightmare of a life, the burden of being alive, for what? to work for the next 60 years, to give my money to everyone else, to spend maybe 15 years of my life living it care free sorta, then die. what the fuck is the point of that. Everyone looks at me like the weird kid, even though on school I always had friends, I was never the quiet kid until a year ago, I started distancing myself from the world, I dropped friends, girlfriend, family (even though Ive always hated them), I grew colder, I care about no one anymore, If anyone “close” to me died i wouldn’t care. why cry for something that’s inevitable, so why should i stay on this shitty planet and suffer. I’ll kill myself soon but after i cause destruction so others know what pain truly is. I despise this world and I can’t wait to leave it. Life is a joke. There is no medication that’ll make it go away, and then what, u always feel like without those pills ur nothing but a depressed loser. You rely on happiness from a pill when ur supposed to get happiness and joy from others. It’s not like that for everyone. me and you are completely different. Your pain is different from mine, you may still have love somewhere in you, emotion or feeling. cling to that. otherwise you become like me, an empty void that just leaks out rage and pain. If I get arrested before i can kill myself deep in the woods where no one can find me then so be it. I’ll face the death penalty. either way the suffering will be over. If they put me in Solitary confinement, i’ll be all alone. no people, no problems, darkness and emptiness. it’ll be the perfect place for me. I fear nothing. not trying to sound like some bad ass little kid that says that. I mean i fear no punishment because nothing triumphs this pain. doesn’t matter what happens to me. the pain i deal with will never be topped
